visible_measurement_notes.units: micrometres as shown in microscope software
visible_measurement_notes.methodology: Unverified individually labeled segments, not guaranteed corresponding to the major axes of single spores. Some overlays are on overlapping or irregular objects. Do not compute a species diagnostic spore range from raw on-screen labels.
visible_measurement_notes.calibration: Original calibration file, objective, optical magnification, reticle calibration, mounting medium, and sampling protocol not supplied
visible_measurement_notes.morphology: Many elliptical-to-bent or crescent-like refractile bodies are visible; possible optical effects, overlap, artifacts, or mixed material. Species-level microscopy unconfirmed

needed_followup: Capture objective magnification and calibration method
Obtain spore print and mount metadata
Measure length and width of a well-defined nonoverlapping sample of 20-30 verified spores
Check ornamentation with appropriate microscopy and scale
Use voucher and DNA barcoding for taxonomic corroboration
safety: Photomicrographs and dimensional annotations do not determine psychoactive chemistry, toxicity, edibility, or human dosage.
preservation: Original PNG pixels retained in user-provided microscopy ZIP and can be imported into per-browser classified gallery; not public-hosted.
